tables.name: crsp_monthly
tables.sql: select permno, date_trunc('month', date)::date as month, exp(sum(ln(1 + ret))) - 1 as ret_m, count(*) as n_days, avg(abs(prc)) as avg_prc, avg(shrout) as avg_shrout from crsp.dsf where date between '2015-01-01' and '2024-12-31' and ret is not null and ret > -1 and hexcd in (1, 2, 3) group by permno, date_trunc('month', date)
